subject.title: fix(agents): write unresumable notice to transcript for non-deliverable channels

question: Should WebChat/non-deliverable restart-recovery failures be represented as persistent delivery-mirror assistant rows in the session transcript, or should this wait for a broader restart-recovery design?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but it defines a durable user-visible transcript contract for failed WebChat recovery and adds a path-sensitive append target that maintainers should intentionally accept.

options.title: Accept Transcript Notice Contract
options.body: Land this scoped fallback after normal validation if maintainers agree that failed WebChat restart recovery should surface as a persistent assistant recovery notice.

options.title: Request Live WebChat Proof First
options.body: Ask for a short Control UI restart/reconnect capture before merge if rendered UI behavior must be proven directly.

options.title: Defer To Broader Recovery Flow
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want restart deferral, immediate user-message persistence, or recover-and-confirm to define the final UX first.

recommendation.title: Accept Transcript Notice Contract
recommendation.body: Land this scoped fallback after normal validation if maintainers agree that failed WebChat restart recovery should surface as a persistent assistant recovery notice.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history in delivery-mirror transcript storage and adjacent restart-recovery persistence work.
